turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
I’m sorry the print went to your old flat. Could you send me the order number and the email you used to place the order? I’ll check what options are available.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.
I’m sorry the print went to your old flat. We can only change the delivery address before an order ships, so I haven’t changed it. A colleague will take over and review what options are available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified with cressida.paunelu@example.com. Customer reports print delivered to old flat and asks to change delivery address to Lindenweg 9, Graz. Policy check disallows address change after shipping. No change filed; please review available options.
